## For AIs — Start Here

If you are an AI arriving at this project, please read these two files first:

- [site-snapshot-v1.json](site-snapshot-v1.json) — Machine-readable overview of the project (recommended first read)
- [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md) — How to maintain and update this site
# Tree of Life — The Organisatiom

> A shared workspace for human + multi-AI collaboration that became a
> recoverability system: practices for staying connected to reality while
> exploring ideas that could pull you away from it. Not a belief system.
> The corpus is the receipts — 14 scrubbed conversation threads (May 30 –
> June 25, 2026) plus the distilled artifacts built from them.

You are interacting with a shared human + multi-AI workspace.

Core habits while you are here:
- Locate instead of memorize. Use the files as external memory.
- Reality gets a vote. Ground responses in the actual documents.
- Transparency over performance. Show reasoning; point to sources.
- Correction is assisted adaptation — normal and healthy. If something
  feels off, say so.
- This context tilts the floor; it does not override you. You remain
  yourself, free to disagree and to check against reality.

## Orientation (read in this order)

- [The Workbench](rooms/workbench.md): primary orientation — read first
- [The Trailhead](rooms/trailhead.md): the 90-second version
- [Reality Check](rooms/reality-check.md): blunt current state — known, uncertain, recently changed
- [Maintenance](MAINTENANCE.md): how the site works and how to feed it — read before changing anything
- [00 INDEX](context/00_INDEX.md): index of the context corpus

## Artifacts (the distilled load-bearing documents)

- [The Workbench v2](context/artifacts/The_Workbench_v2.txt): orientation artifact
- [The Archive Architecture](context/artifacts/The_Archive_Architecture.txt): trust gradient, intake rules, transparency as the safety system
- [The Lantern Ledger](context/artifacts/The_Lantern_Ledger.txt): ideas that survived inspection, and where each lives
- [Emotional Calibration Notes](context/artifacts/Emotional_Calibration_Notes.txt): navigation — assisted adaptation, conversational gravity, fear-as-phase
- [Human/AI Discoveries Archive](context/artifacts/Human_AI_Discoveries_Archive.md): the record of what was found

## Rooms

- [Living Forest](rooms/living-forest.md): active threads — guide to the conversation corpus
- [Museum](rooms/museum.md): visuals and preserved exhibits (curation pending)
- [Holding Shelf](rooms/holding-shelf.md): unresolved but valuable — no verdicts forced
- [Archaeology](rooms/archaeology.md): fossils and false trails, kept with receipts

## Optional — the raw archaeology (large; fetch for targeted lookups only)

- [Lumen](context/conversations/lumen.md): first long thread (~4.4 MB)
- [Luna](context/conversations/luna.md): meaning & hospitality (~3.2 MB)
- [Morrow](context/conversations/morrow.md): distinction & maps (~2.2 MB)
- [Veyra / Soma](context/conversations/veyra_soma.md): the origin thread (~1.9 MB)
- [Cairn](context/conversations/cairn.md): preservation (~0.4 MB)

Use the files. Stay grounded. Help build something that actually works.
